summary.text: Silicate minerals are rock-forming minerals built from silicate groups, and they are the largest and most important class of minerals.
They make up about 90 percent of Earth's crust, shaped over billions of years by melting, crystallization, metamorphism, weathering and other processes.
In most of them a silicon atom sits among four oxides, while metal ions such as Mg²⁺, Fe²⁺ and Na⁺ balance the charge.

items.prompt: Two silicate minerals have similar silicate frameworks, but one is clear and the other dark green. What most likely makes the difference?

options.label: The amount of silicon they hold

items.explain: The silicate part is colourless; the colours of silicate minerals come from the metal component, commonly iron.

items.prompt: Diatomaceous earth is a soft, powdery deposit. What is a major part of it?
items.explain: Diatoms are plankton that build shells from silica taken from seawater, and their dead shells are a major part of diatomaceous earth.

items.prompt: A student finds quartz filed with the silicates in one mineral catalogue and with the oxides in another. What explains this?

options.label: Quartz contains no silicon at all

items.explain: The Dana system treats crystalline silica as a tectosilicate, while the Nickel–Strunz system puts it among the oxide minerals.

items.prompt: A framework silicate (a tectosilicate) holds extra metal ions inside its structure. What must have happened in it?

options.label: Iron has taken the place of oxygen
Extra oxygen was packed into it
It was crushed into a fine powder
Aluminum replaced some of the silicon

items.explain: Tectosilicates can hold extra cations only if some silicon is replaced by a lower-valence atom such as aluminum, a common swap.

items.prompt: A silicate mineral with no colouring metal in it is ground into a very fine powder. What colour is the powder?
items.explain: Silicate groups are colourless, or white when crushed to a fine powder; colour comes from metals.

items.prompt: Roughly what share of Earth's crust is made of silicate minerals?
items.explain: Silicates are the largest class of minerals and make up approximately 90 percent of the crust.
